text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cape Verde Prime Minister Carlos Veiga says his country will reconsider its position on Western Sahara.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri visits Italy and signs accord to cooperate against terrorism and drug trafficking with Italian counterpart Giorgio Napolitano.
- Rumours of possible merger between Wafabank and Uniban.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali says during debate in parliament over draft law on telecommunications "liberalisation of the sector does not mean that the state will withdraw its commitments".
- New impulse to Moroccan-Canadian cooperation after visit of International Cooperation Minister Don Boudria.
- Railway workers union threatens to stage a two-day strike to protest against management indifference to their demands for pay increases and other benefits.
